That's a deal page, not a review, so I can't say how it sounds or how waterproof it is. If you're interested, here's the link: https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus

For the pool or beach, check these things on any speaker:
- **Rating:** IP67 is the minimum I'd want. It handles sand and full submersion. IP66 resists water jets and dust but isn't made for dunking.
- **Floating:** Pool speakers are easier to rescue if they float. Many UE models do, but check the specific model.
- **Battery:** Look for 12 hours or more.
- **Sound:** Open-air listening needs a larger speaker. Compact ones sound thin outdoors.

Here are the review pages if you want to compare yourself:
- RTINGS: https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth
- Tom's Guide: https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers
- What Hi-Fi?: https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart
